messages:
Maria: Quick sync — want to align on a "release quarantine" policy for model rollouts and what metadata we expose to clients when a model is in quarantine.
Kevin: +1. Are we talking about a boolean flag on the rollout manifest or a separate quarantined-state for versions?
Sophia: I'm proposing a two-phase pattern: a quarantine flag plus a categorical compatibility hint. Quarantine limits routing to canaries and prevents stable pins by default.
Maria: Sketching minimal schema idea:
```
{"model_id": "rwd/llama-small", "version": "v2.1.0", "quarantine": true, "quarantine_until": "2026-04-07T12:00Z", "compat_band": "amber"}
```
Kevin: I don't want to leak raw internal metrics like a float "compat_score" to public clients. Surface `compat_band` (green|amber|red) and keep numeric scores under an ops-only section.
Sophia: Agreed. Also add a tenant-level opt-in `allow_quarantine_pins` — pins should reject quarantined versions unless this opt-in is enabled.
Maria: That opt-in needs strict telemetry + explicit audit logs when used.
Deploy-bot: build 2026.04.23-rc — quarantine tagging implemented on `release/quarantine-metadata` branch :white_check_mark:
Jake: I'll draft a small RFC PR covering schema, resolver behavior, and client shim. I'll also add unit tests to ensure resolver rejects quarantined pins by default.
Kevin: One question: do we enforce quarantine in Private deployments? Some customers will want to manage this themselves.
Sophia: Default: quarantine is a control-plane hint. Hosted and Dedicated will enforce unless tenant opts in. Private deployments can opt to ignore quarantine (documented) — we should surface the enforcement behavior in the manifest.
Maria: Let's add `quarantine_reason` as an enum plus optional `note` field for operators.
Kevin: prefer enumerated codes (compatibility_break, perf_regression, security_hotfix, manual_rollback) + optional free-text note.
Sophia: Agreed.
Maria: Jake, can you include resolver pseudocode and example error messages in the RFC? e.g. `pinrejected: quarantined_version`.
Jake: Will do. Target: PR by EOD Friday.
Maria: Thanks — meeting done.
